function v36.Open(p_u_82) -- name: Open
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_10, (ref) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_24, (copy) v_u_20
	if not (v_u_10.IsBusy:get() or p_u_82.Player:GetAttribute("InPod")) then
		v_u_9:SetFlag(v_u_24.Ability1)
		v_u_10.IsBusy:set(true)
		local v_u_83
		if p_u_82.Player.Character then
			v_u_83 = p_u_82.Player.Character:FindFirstChild("Nametag")
		else
			v_u_83 = nil
		end
		v_u_20({
			["Duration"] = 0.5,
			["OnHidden"] = nil,
			["OnEnd"] = nil,
			["OnHidden"] = function() -- name: OnHidden
				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_82, (ref) v_u_10, (ref) v_u_83
				if p_u_82.Player:GetAttribute("InPod") then
					v_u_10.IsBusy:set(false)
				else
					p_u_82:SetScene()
					v_u_10:SelectLobbyMenu("Abilities", false, nil, true)
					v_u_10.IsMobileQuickButtonVisible:set(false)
					if v_u_83 then
						v_u_83.Enabled = false
					end
				end
			end,
			["OnEnd"] = function() -- name: OnEnd
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_10
				v_u_10.IsBusy:set(false)
			end
		})
	end
end
function v36.SetScene(p_u_84) -- name: SetScene
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_19, (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_21, (copy) v_u_14, (copy) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_30, (copy) v_u_22
	if p_u_84.Scene then
		if p_u_84.Scene ~= true then
			v_u_19.lookAt(p_u_84.Scene)
		end
	else
		p_u_84.Scene = true
		local v85 = v_u_1:GetTagged("AbilityBackground")[1]
		p_u_84.Scene = v_u_21()
		p_u_84.Scene:PivotTo(v85:WaitForChild("Character").CFrame)
		p_u_84.Scene.Parent = v85
		local v_u_89 = v_u_14.Computed(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_84, (ref) v_u_16, (ref) v_u_30
			local v86 = (p_u_84.Abilities:get() or {})[p_u_84.CurrentAbilitySlot:get() or 1]
			if not v86 then
				return {}
			end
			local v_u_87 = v_u_16:Get(v86)
			task.spawn(function()
				-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_87, (ref) v_u_30, (ref) p_u_84
				local v88 = v_u_87 and v_u_87.Metadata
				if v88 then
					v88 = v_u_87.Metadata.Limbs
				end
				if v88 and v_u_87.Metadata.IgnoreLimbListInScene then
					v88 = nil
				end
				v_u_30.applyForPlayer(p_u_84.Scene, v_u_87.Rarity, true, v88)
			end)
			return v_u_87 or {}
		end)
		local v_u_90 = Color3.new()
		v_u_14.Hydrate(v85.LightPart.SpotLight)({
			["Color"] = v_u_14.Computed(function()
				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_84, (ref) v_u_90, (ref) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_89
				if p_u_84.IsSpinning:get() then
					return v_u_90
				end
				v_u_90 = v_u_16.Rarity.Data[v_u_89:get().Rarity or v_u_16.Rarity.Type.Common].Color
				return v_u_90
			end)
		})
		local v91 = Instance.new("Animation")
		local v92 = p_u_84.Scene:WaitForChild("Humanoid"):WaitForChild("Animator")
		v91.AnimationId = v_u_22.Idle.Id
		v91.Parent = p_u_84.Scene
		local v93 = v92:LoadAnimation(v91)
		v93.Looped = true
		v93.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Idle
		v93:Play()
		v_u_19.lookAt(p_u_84.Scene)
		return
	end
end
function v36.Close(p94) -- name: Close
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_20, (copy) v_u_19
	if v_u_10.App.Parent == nil then
		return
	elseif not v_u_10.IsBusy:get() then
		v_u_10.IsBusy:set(true)
		local v_u_95 = p94.Player.Character:FindFirstChild("Nametag")
		v_u_20({
			["Duration"] = 0.5,
			["OnHidden"] = nil,
			["OnEnd"] = nil,
			["OnHidden"] = function() -- name: OnHidden
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_19, (ref) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_95
				v_u_19.lookAt(nil)
				v_u_10.IsMobileQuickButtonVisible:set(true)
				if v_u_10.App.Lobby.Abilities.Visible then
					v_u_10:SelectLobbyMenu("Abilities", true, nil, true)
				end
				if v_u_95 then
					v_u_95.Enabled = true
				end
			end,
			["OnEnd"] = function() -- name: OnEnd
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_10
				v_u_10.IsBusy:set(false)
			end
		})
	end
end
function v36.Spin(p_u_96, p97, p98) -- name: Spin
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_35, (copy) v_u_25, (copy) v_u_16, (ref) v_u_12, (ref) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_5, (ref) v_u_10, (ref) v_u_11
	p_u_96.IsLucky = p97
	if p_u_96.LockedSlots:get()[p_u_96.CurrentAbilitySlot:get()] == true then
		v_u_35.send({
			["Body"] = "This slot is locked!",
			["Color"] = nil,
			["Color"] = v_u_25.Notification.Red
		})
		return
	else
		if not p98 and p_u_96.WarnBeforeSpinning:get() then
			local v99
			if p97 then
				v99 = p_u_96.LuckySpins
			else
				v99 = p_u_96.Spins:get() >= 0
			end
			if v99 then
				local v100 = p_u_96.AbilityData:get()
				local v101
				if v100 then
					v101 = v_u_16.Rarity.Data[v100.Rarity].Color
				else
					v101 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
				end
				v_u_12:Open({
					["Icon"] = "rbxassetid://80134329391524",
					["Header"] = "CONFIRM SPIN",
					["Body"] = nil,
					["Option1"] = "SPIN",
					["Option2"] = "KEEP",
					["OpenedMenu"] = "Abilities",
					["Callback1"] = nil,
					["Body"] = ("Are you sure you want to spin off <font color=\'#%*\'>%*</font>?"):format(v101:ToHex(), v100.DisplayName),
					["Callback1"] = function() -- name: Callback1
						-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_96
						p_u_96:Spin(p_u_96.IsLucky, true)
					end
				})
				return
			end
		end
		if p_u_96.SpinDebounce <= os.clock() and not p_u_96.IsRolling then
			p_u_96.IsRolling = true
			p_u_96.Debounce:set(true)
			local v102, v103, v_u_104 = v_u_7:Roll(p97 or false):await()
			p_u_96.IsRolling = false
			if not v102 then
				v103 = false
				v_u_104 = nil
			end
			if v103 then
				local v105 = v_u_104[#v_u_104]
				table.insert(v_u_104, v105)
				p_u_96.IsSpinning:set(true)
				p_u_96.SpinArray:set(v_u_104)
				p_u_96.SpinIndexIntValue.Value = 1
				v_u_5:Create(p_u_96.SpinIndexIntValue, v_u_16.SpinTweenInfo, {
					["Value"] = #v_u_104
				}):Play()
				p_u_96:WaitUntilSpinFinishedAync()
				task.spawn(function()
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_104, (ref) v_u_16, (copy) p_u_96
					p_u_96:PlayCutscene(v_u_16:Get(v_u_104[#v_u_104]).Rarity)
				end)
			elseif v_u_104 then
				local v106
				if p97 then
					v106 = p_u_96.LuckySpins:get()
				else
					v106 = p_u_96.Spins:get()
				end
				if v106 > 0 or v_u_10.ArePaidRandomItemsRestricted then
					v_u_35.handleServerResult(v103, v_u_104)
				else
					local v107 = v_u_11
					local v108
					if p97 then
						v108 = v_u_11.Type.LuckyAbility
					else
						v108 = v_u_11.Type.Ability
					end
					v107:Open(v108)
				end
			end
			p_u_96.SpinDebounce = os.clock() + 0.5
			p_u_96.IsSpinning:set(false)
			p_u_96.Debounce:set(false)
		end
	end
end
function v36.WaitUntilSpinFinishedAync(p109) -- name: WaitUntilSpinFinishedAync
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_18
	local v110 = nil
	while p109.SpinIndexIntValue.Value ~= #p109.SpinArray:get() do
		if p109.IsSpinning:get() ~= true then
			p109.SpinIndexIntValue.Value = #p109.SpinArray:get()
			return
		end

				if v120 and not table.find(v120, p_u_114.Id) then
					p_u_113._capturing[p_u_114.Id] = nil
				else
					local v121 = v_u_15.capture
					local v122 = p_u_114.Id
					local v123 = p_u_114.Plan
					local v124 = v_u_118
					local v125 = p_u_113.Buffer
					local v126 = p_u_114.IsEarned
					local v127, v128 = pcall(v121, v122, v123, v124, v125, v126)
					if not v127 then
						v_u_14:Warn((("Could not keep point %*: %*"):format(p_u_114.Id, v128)))
					end
					p_u_113._capturing[p_u_114.Id] = nil
					local v129 = p_u_113._pendingReplays[p_u_114.Id]
					p_u_113._pendingReplays[p_u_114.Id] = nil
					if v129 then
						p_u_113:_PlayKept(p_u_114.Id, v129)
					end
				end
			else
				return
			end
		end)
		local v130 = p_u_114.Vote
		if v130 and p_u_113:IsPlayer() then
			p_u_113._voteId = p_u_114.Id
			v_u_26.show({
				["Duration"] = v130.Duration,
				["Needed"] = v130.Needed,
				["OnVote"] = function() -- name: OnVote
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_29, (copy) p_u_114
					v_u_29.ReplayVote:Fire(p_u_114.Id)
				end
			})
		end
	else
		return
	end
end
function v31._PlayPoint(p131, p132, p133) -- name: _PlayPoint

end

end
function v31._PlayEntry(p_u_138, p_u_139, p_u_140, p_u_141) -- name: _PlayEntry
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_32, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_28, (copy) v_u_21, (copy) v_u_14
	p_u_138:Teardown()
	local v_u_142 = v_u_32()
	p_u_138._run = v_u_142
	v_u_142.Maid:GiveTask(v_u_3:GetAttributeChangedSignal("RoundState"):Connect(function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_3, (ref) v_u_9, (copy) p_u_138, (copy) v_u_142
		if v_u_3:GetAttribute("RoundState") ~= v_u_9.State.Live then
			p_u_138:_EndRun(v_u_142)
		end
	end))
	local v143 = task.delay
	local v144 = p_u_141 - os.clock()
	v_u_142.Deadline = v143(math.max(v144, 0), function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_142, (copy) p_u_138
		v_u_142.Deadline = nil
		p_u_138:_EndRun(v_u_142)
	end)
	v_u_142.Thread = task.spawn(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_138, (copy) v_u_142, (copy) p_u_139, (copy) p_u_140, (ref) v_u_28, (ref) v_u_21, (copy) p_u_141, (ref) v_u_14
		local function v149()
			-- upvalues: (ref) p_u_138, (ref) v_u_142, (ref) p_u_139, (ref) p_u_140, (ref) v_u_28, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) p_u_141
			local v_u_145 = p_u_138:_Prepare(v_u_142, p_u_139, "REPLAY")
			if v_u_145 then
				if p_u_138:_WaitUntil(v_u_142, p_u_140 - v_u_28.FadeTime) then
					v_u_21.fade(function()
						-- upvalues: (ref) p_u_138, (ref) v_u_142, (copy) v_u_145
						p_u_138:_Reveal(v_u_142, v_u_145)
					end)
					while not (v_u_145.PlayStart or v_u_142.IsDisposed) do
						task.wait()
					end
					local v146
					if v_u_145.PlayStart then
						local v147 = v_u_145.PlayStart + p_u_139.Plan.Clip
						local v148 = p_u_141 - v_u_28.FadeTime * 2
						v146 = math.min(v147, v148)
					else
						v146 = p_u_140 + p_u_139.Plan.Clip
					end
					if p_u_138:_WaitUntil(v_u_142, v146) then
						v_u_21.fade(function()
							-- upvalues: (ref) p_u_138, (ref) v_u_142
							p_u_138:_EndRun(v_u_142)
						end)
					end
				else
					return
				end
			else
				p_u_138:_EndRun(v_u_142)
				return
			end
		end
		local v150, v151 = pcall(v149)
		if not v150 then
			v_u_14:Warn((("The replay stopped early: %*"):format(v151)))
			p_u_138:_EndRun(v_u_142)
		end
	end)
end
function v31._PrepareReel(p_u_152, p_u_153, p_u_154) -- name: _PrepareReel
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_32, (copy) v_u_28, (copy) v_u_15, (copy) v_u_16
	p_u_152:_DisposeReel()
	if not p_u_154 then
		p_u_152._reelIds = p_u_153.Ids
	end
	p_u_152:_CheckMemory()
	if #p_u_153.Ids ~= 0 and (p_u_152:IsPlayer() and p_u_152:IsWatcher()) then
		local v_u_155 = v_u_32()
		p_u_152._reel = v_u_155
		v_u_155.Expiry = task.delay(v_u_28.Reel.Expiry, function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_155, (copy) p_u_152
			v_u_155.Expiry = nil
			if p_u_152._reel == v_u_155 then
				p_u_152:_DisposeReel()
			end
		end)
		v_u_155.Thread = task.spawn(function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_28, (copy) p_u_153, (copy) p_u_152, (copy) v_u_155, (ref) v_u_15, (copy) p_u_154, (ref) v_u_16
			local v156 = os.clock() + v_u_28.EffectTail + 1
			local v157 = {}
			for _, v158 in p_u_153.Ids do
				while p_u_152._capturing[v158] and (os.clock() < v156 and not v_u_155.IsDisposed) do
					task.wait()
				end
				local v159 = v_u_15.get(v158)
				if not v159 then
					break
				end
				table.insert(v157, v159)
			end
			if not v_u_155.IsDisposed then
				local v_u_160 = {}
				for v161, v162 in v157 do
					v_u_160[v162] = true
					local v163 = v_u_155.Plans
					local v164 = v162.Plan
					table.insert(v163, v164)
					local v165 = v_u_155.Upcoming
					local v166 = {
						["Entry"] = v162,
						["Subtitle"] = ("%*  \194\183  %*/%*"):format(p_u_153.Mvp, v161, #v157)
					}
					table.insert(v165, v166)
				end
				if not p_u_154 then
					v_u_15.release(function(p167)
						-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_160
						return v_u_160[p167] == true
					end)
					v_u_16.setHalted(true)
				end
				p_u_152:_StageNext(v_u_155)
			end
		end)
	end
end
function v31._StageNext(p168, p169) -- name: _StageNext
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_14
	while #p169.Upcoming > 0 and not p169.IsDisposed do
		local v170 = table.remove(p169.Upcoming, 1)
		local v171 = p168._Prepare
		local v172 = v170.Entry
		local v173 = v170.Subtitle
		local v174, v175 = pcall(v171, p168, p169, v172, "MVP REEL", v173)
		if v174 then
			if not v175 then
				continue
			end
			local v176 = p169.Queue
			table.insert(v176, v175)
			return v175
		end
		v_u_14:Warn((("Could not stage a reel point: %*"):format(v175)))
	end
	return nil
end
function v31.PlayReel(p_u_177, p_u_178) -- name: PlayReel
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_29, (copy) v_u_78, (copy) v_u_28, (copy) v_u_13, (copy) v_u_24, (copy) v_u_21, (copy) v_u_14
	if v_u_29 then
		local v_u_179 = p_u_177._reel
		p_u_177._reel = nil
		p_u_177:_ForgetMatch()
		if v_u_179 then
			local v180 = v_u_179.Thread
			if v180 and v180 ~= coroutine.running() then
				local v181 = task.cancel
				pcall(v181, v180)
			end
			local v182 = v_u_179.Expiry
			if v182 and v182 ~= coroutine.running() then
				local v183 = task.cancel
				pcall(v183, v182)
			end
			v_u_179.Thread = nil
			v_u_179.Expiry = nil
			for _, v184 in v_u_179.Sessions do
				if table.find(v_u_179.Queue, v184) then
					continue
				end
				v_u_78(v184)
			end
		end
		if v_u_179 and #v_u_179.Queue ~= 0 then
			p_u_177:Teardown()
			p_u_177._run = v_u_179
			v_u_179.IsReel = true
			function v_u_179.OnEnded()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_29, (copy) p_u_178
				v_u_29.ReelFinished:Fire()
				p_u_178()
			end
			local v185
			if #v_u_179.Plans > 0 then
				v185 = v_u_179.Plans
			else
				v185 = { v_u_179.Queue[1].Entry.Plan }
			end
			for _, v186 in v185 do
				v_u_179.ReelDuration = v_u_179.ReelDuration + v186.Clip
			end
			v_u_179.ReelDuration = v_u_179.ReelDuration - v_u_28.FadeTime
			v_u_179.Deadline = task.delay(v_u_13.reelLength(v185) + 2 + 6, function()
				-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_179, (copy) p_u_177
				v_u_179.Deadline = nil
				p_u_177:_EndRun(v_u_179)
			end)
			local v_u_187 = v_u_179.Queue[1]
			p_u_177:_Reveal(v_u_179, v_u_187)
			if p_u_177:CanSkipReel() and not v_u_179.IsDisposed then
				v_u_24.show(function()
					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_177
					p_u_177:SkipReel()
				end)
				v_u_179.SkipShown = true
			end
			v_u_179.Thread = task.spawn(function()
				-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_187, (ref) v_u_21, (copy) p_u_177, (copy) v_u_179, (ref) v_u_28, (ref) v_u_14
				local function v192()
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_187, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) p_u_177, (ref) v_u_179, (ref) v_u_28
					local v_u_188 = v_u_187
					if v_u_188 then
						local v189
						if v_u_188 == v_u_187 then
							v189 = v_u_188
						else
							v_u_21.fade(function()
								-- upvalues: (ref) p_u_177, (ref) v_u_179, (copy) v_u_188
								p_u_177:_Reveal(v_u_179, v_u_188)
							end)
							v189 = v_u_188
							while not (v_u_188.PlayStart or v_u_179.IsDisposed) do
								task.wait()
							end
						end
						if v_u_179.IsDisposed or not v189.PlayStart then
							return
						else
							v_u_188 = nil
							local v_u_190 = #v_u_179.Upcoming == 0
							if not v_u_190 then
								v_u_179.Builder = task.spawn(function()
									-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_188, (ref) p_u_177, (ref) v_u_179, (ref) v_u_190
									v_u_188 = p_u_177:_StageNext(v_u_179)
									v_u_190 = true
									v_u_179.Builder = nil
								end)
							end
							local v191 = v189.Entry.Plan
							if p_u_177:_WaitUntil(v_u_179, v189.PlayStart + v191.Clip - v_u_28.FadeTime) then
								while not (v_u_190 or v_u_179.IsDisposed) do
									task.wait()
								end
								if not v_u_179.IsDisposed then
									break
								end
							end
						end
					else
						p_u_177:_FinishReel(v_u_179, false)
						return
					end
				end
				local v193, v194 = pcall(v192)
				if not v193 then
					v_u_14:Warn((("The reel stopped early: %*"):format(v194)))
					p_u_177:_EndRun(v_u_179)
				end
			end)
		else
			if v_u_179 then
				p_u_177:_DisposeRun(v_u_179)
			end
			v_u_29.ReelFinished:Fire()
			p_u_178()
		end
	else
		p_u_178()
		return
	end
end
function v31.CanSkipReel(_) -- name: CanSkipReel

	local v195 = v_u_2.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute(v_u_28.Reel.Skip.Attribute)
	if v195 == nil then
		return v_u_28.Reel.Skip.Default
	else
		return v195
	end
end
function v31.SkipReel(p196) -- name: SkipReel
	local v197 = p196._run
	if v197 and (v197.IsReel and not (v197.IsFinishing or v197.IsDisposed)) then
		local v198 = v197.Thread
		if v198 and v198 ~= coroutine.running() then
			local v199 = task.cancel
			pcall(v199, v198)
		end
		v197.Thread = nil
		p196:_FinishReel(v197, true)
	end
end
function v31._FinishReel(p_u_200, p_u_201, p_u_202) -- name: _FinishReel
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_24, (copy) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_29, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_62
	if not (p_u_201.IsFinishing or p_u_201.IsDisposed) then
		p_u_201.IsFinishing = true
		v_u_24.hide()
		local v_u_203 = {}
		local v204 = os.clock() - p_u_201.Queue[1].PlayStart
		v_u_203.watch_seconds = math.max(0, v204)
		v_u_203.reel_duration_seconds = p_u_201.ReelDuration
		v_u_203.clip_count = #p_u_201.Queue
		v_u_21.fade(function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_29, (copy) p_u_202, (copy) p_u_201, (copy) v_u_203, (ref) v_u_4, (ref) v_u_62, (copy) p_u_200
			v_u_29.ReelFinished:Fire(p_u_202, p_u_201.SkipShown, v_u_203)
			local v205 = p_u_201.Builder
			if v205 and v205 ~= coroutine.running() then
				local v206 = task.cancel
				pcall(v206, v205)
			end
			p_u_201.Builder = nil
			if p_u_201.IsBound then
				p_u_201.IsBound = false
				v_u_4:UnbindFromRenderStep("ReplayStage")
			end
			if p_u_201.Current then
				v_u_62(p_u_201.Current)
			end
			p_u_200:_WaitForLobby()
			p_u_200:_EndRun(p_u_201)
		end, true)
	end
end
function v31._WaitForLobby(_) -- name: _WaitForLobby
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_2
	local v207 = os.clock() + 6
	while v_u_11.get(v_u_2.LocalPlayer, v_u_11.Id.Gameplay, "InGame") == true and os.clock() < v207 do
		task.wait(0.1)
	end
	task.wait(0.2)
end
function v31._ForgetMatch(p208) -- name: _ForgetMatch

	p208._generation = p208._generation + 1
	p208._reelIds = nil

end
function v31._DisposeReel(p209) -- name: _DisposeReel
	local v210 = p209._reel
	p209._reel = nil
	if v210 then
		p209:_DisposeRun(v210)

end
function v31._Prepare(_, p211, p212, p213, p214) -- name: _Prepare
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_18, (copy) v_u_20, (copy) v_u_19, (copy) v_u_22, (copy) v_u_25, (copy) v_u_23, (copy) v_u_17, (copy) v_u_28
	local v215 = v_u_18.getCourt()
	if v215 then
		local v216 = Instance.new("Folder")
		v216.Name = "Replay"
		local v217 = {
			["Entry"] = nil,
			["Title"] = nil,
			["Subtitle"] = nil,
			["Folder"] = nil,
			["IsDisposed"] = false,
			["Entry"] = p212,
			["Title"] = p213,
			["Subtitle"] = p214,
			["Folder"] = v216
		}
		local v218 = p211.Sessions
		table.insert(v218, v217)
		local v219 = v_u_20.new(p212.Clip, p212.Cast, v216)
		v217.Ghosts = v219
		v217.Ball = v_u_19.new(p212.Clip, p212.BallSkin, v216)
		v217.RikuWalls = v_u_22.new(p212.Clip, p212.Walls.RikuSpans, v216)
		v217.VineWalls = v_u_25.new(p212.Walls.VineWalls, v216)

		v217.Cues = v_u_17.new(p212.Clip, v219, v217.Ball, p212.Plan.Tail)
		local v220 = os.clock()
		local v221 = 0
		while v219:BuildNext() do
			v221 = v221 + 1
			if v_u_28.BuildPerFrame > v221 and os.clock() - v220 < v_u_28.BuildBudget then
				continue
			end
			task.wait()
			if p211.IsDisposed then
				return nil
			end
			v220 = os.clock()
			v221 = 0
		end
		if p211.IsDisposed then
			return nil
		else
			return v217
		end
	else
		return nil
	end
end
function v31._WaitUntil(_, p222, p223) -- name: _WaitUntil
	local v224 = p223 - os.clock()
	if v224 > 0 then
		task.wait(v224)
	end
	return not p222.IsDisposed
end
function v31._Reveal(p_u_225, p_u_226, p_u_227) -- name: _Reveal
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_78, (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_27, (copy) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_48, (copy) v_u_21, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_14
	if not (p_u_226.IsDisposed or (p_u_226.IsFinishing or p_u_227.IsDisposed)) then
		local function v231()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_226, (copy) p_u_227, (ref) v_u_78, (ref) v_u_2, (copy) p_u_225, (ref) v_u_27, (ref) v_u_16, (ref) v_u_48, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_4
			local v228 = p_u_226.Current
			if v228 then
				if v228.Veil then
					p_u_227.Veil = v228.Veil
					v228.Veil = nil
				end

			else

					-- upvalues: (ref) p_u_225, (ref) p_u_226
					p_u_225:_EndRun(p_u_226)
				end))
			end
			v_u_27.clearLive()
			p_u_226.IsPausing = true
			v_u_16.setPaused(true)
			local v229 = p_u_227.Director
			p_u_227.Folder.Parent = workspace:FindFirstChild("Effects") or workspace
			p_u_227.Ghosts:Reveal()
			p_u_227.Veil:Enable(v_u_48(p_u_227.Entry, v229.Court), p_u_227.Folder)
			v_u_21.show(p_u_227.Title, p_u_227.Subtitle)
			p_u_227.Director:Start()
			p_u_227.PlayStart = os.clock()
			p_u_226.Current = p_u_227
			if not p_u_226.IsBound then
				p_u_226.IsBound = true
				v_u_4:BindToRenderStep("ReplayStage", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function(p230)
					-- upvalues: (ref) p_u_225, (ref) p_u_226
					p_u_225:_Step(p_u_226, p230)
				end)
			end
		end
		local v232, v233 = pcall(v231)
		if not v232 then
			v_u_14:Warn((("The replay could not start: %*"):format(v233)))
			p_u_225:_EndRun(p_u_226)
		end
	end
end
function v31._Step(p234, p235, p_u_236) -- name: _Step
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_14
	local v_u_237 = p235.Current
	if not p235.IsDisposed and (v_u_237 and v_u_237.PlayStart) then
		debug.profilebegin("Replay::Play")
		local v241, v242 = pcall(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_237, (copy) p_u_236
			local v238 = v_u_237.Entry.Clip.Duration
			local v239 = os.clock() - v_u_237.PlayStart
			local v240 = math.min(v239, v238)
			v_u_237.Ghosts:Update(v240)
			if v_u_237.Ball then
				v_u_237.Ball:Update(v240, v240 >= v238 and 0 or p_u_236)
			end
			if v_u_237.RikuWalls then
				v_u_237.RikuWalls:Update(v240)
			end
			if v_u_237.VineWalls then
				v_u_237.VineWalls:Update(v240)

		p_u_38.SpinIndexIntValue = Instance.new("IntValue")
		p_u_38.Component = p_u_38:LoadComponent()
		p_u_38.Debounce = v_u_18.Value(false)
		p_u_38.SecretConfirmationMenuVisibility = v_u_18.Value(false)
		p_u_38.PreferredStyleToChange = v_u_18.Value(nil)
		p_u_38.IsLucky = false
		p_u_38.WarnBeforeSpinning = v_u_18.Computed(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_38, (ref) v_u_11, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_15, (ref) v_u_17
			local v51 = p_u_38:GetPendingStyleData()
			if v51 and v_u_11:ShouldConfirmSpin(v51.Rarity) then
				return true
			end
			local v52 = (p_u_38.Styles:get() or {})[p_u_38.CurrentStyleSlot:get() or 1]
			if not v52 then
				return false
			end
			local v53 = v_u_21:Get(v52)
			if not v53 then
				return false
			end
			v_u_15 = v_u_15 or v_u_17.GetController("MasteryController")
			return v_u_11:ShouldConfirmSpin(v53.Rarity) or v_u_15.HasUnsavedMastery:get()
		end)
		v_u_34(p_u_38)
		p_u_38:BindToOpen()
		p_u_38:BindToCharacter()
		v_u_7.PlayRollCutscene:Connect(function(p54)
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_16, (copy) p_u_38
			v_u_16:StopStyleAnimations("Pose")
			v_u_16:StopStyleAnimations("PoseStart")
			v_u_16:PlayAnimation("Pose", {
				["FadeTime"] = 0
			})
			p_u_38:PlayCutscene(p54)
		end)
		v_u_11.App.Lobby.Styles:SetAttribute("IsLoaded", true)
	end
end

function v36.BindToSpinsAsync(p56) -- name: BindToSpinsAsync
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_18, (copy) v_u_29
	if p56.Spins or (p56.LuckySpins or (p56.Pity or (p56.CurrentStyleSlot or (p56.SecretPity or (p56.SecretPityUsed or (p56.UltraPity or p56.EvoPity)))))) then
		return p56.Spins, p56.LuckySpins, p56.Pity, p56.CurrentStyleSlot, p56.SecretPity, p56.SecretPityUsed, p56.UltraPity, p56.EvoPity
	end
	local v57 = v_u_6:Get("Statistics"):expect()
	local v_u_58 = v_u_18.Value(v57.StyleSpins)
	local v_u_59 = v_u_18.Value(v57.StyleLuckySpins)
	local v_u_60 = v_u_18.Value(v57.Pity)
	local v_u_61 = v_u_18.Value(v57.SecretPity)
	local v62 = v_u_29.bindAsync("Style").ActiveIndex
	local v_u_63 = v_u_18.Value(v57.SecretPitySpun)
	local v_u_64 = v_u_18.Value(v57.UltraPity)
	local v_u_65 = v_u_18.Value(v57.EvoPity)
	v_u_6.ProfileUpdated:Connect(function(p66, p67)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_58, (copy) v_u_59, (copy) v_u_60, (copy) v_u_61, (copy) v_u_63, (copy) v_u_64, (copy) v_u_65
		if p66 == "Statistics" then
			v_u_58:set(p67.StyleSpins)
			v_u_59:set(p67.StyleLuckySpins)
			v_u_60:set(p67.Pity)
			v_u_61:set(p67.SecretPity)
			v_u_63:set(p67.SecretPitySpun)
			v_u_64:set(p67.UltraPity)
			v_u_65:set(p67.EvoPity)
		end
	end)
	return v_u_58, v_u_59, v_u_60, v62, v_u_61, v_u_63, v_u_64, v_u_65
end
function v36.BindToStylesAsync(p68) -- name: BindToStylesAsync
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_29, (copy) v_u_18, (copy) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_13, (copy) v_u_33, (ref) v_u_16
	if p68.Styles or p68.Style then
		return p68.Styles, p68.Style
	end
	local _, _, _, v_u_69, _, _ = p68:BindToSpinsAsync()
	local v_u_70 = p68:BindToForcedStyle()
	local v_u_71 = v_u_29.bindAsync("Style").Ids
	return v_u_71, v_u_18.Computed(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_70, (copy) v_u_71, (copy) v_u_69, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_13, (ref) v_u_33, (ref) v_u_16
		local v72 = v_u_70:get() or (v_u_71:get() or {})[v_u_69:get() or 1]
		if not v72 then
			return {}
		end
		local v_u_73 = v_u_21:Get(v72)
		task.spawn(function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_13, (copy) v_u_73
			v_u_13:SetSpecialFromStyle(v_u_73)
		end)
		local v74
		if v_u_33.Character == nil then
			v74 = false
		else
			v74 = v_u_33.Character:GetAttribute("Jumping") == true
		end
		if not v74 then
			v_u_16:StopStyleAnimations("SpikeJump")
			v_u_16:StopStyleAnimations("SpikeIdle")
		end
		v_u_16:StopStyleAnimations("SpikeHitIdle")
		v_u_16:StopStyleAnimations("Spike", v74 and {
			["Filter"] = { "SpikeJump", "SpikeIdle" }
		} or nil)
		task.defer(function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_16
			v_u_16:StopStyleAnimations("Idle", {
				["Filter"] = {
					"Jump",
					"Set",
					"Block",
					"Spike"
				}
			})
			v_u_16:PlayAnimation("Idle")
		end)
		return v_u_73
	end)
end

function v36.BindToOpen(p_u_113) -- name: BindToOpen
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_18
	local v114 = v_u_18.Observer(p_u_113.IsVisible)
	v114:onChange(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_113
		if p_u_113.IsVisible:get() == true then
			p_u_113:OnOpen()
		else
			p_u_113:OnClose()
		end
	end)
	v114:update()
end
function v36.OnOpen(p115) -- name: OnOpen
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_26, (ref) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_24, (ref) v_u_16
	v_u_10:SetFlag(v_u_26.Style1)
	v_u_11.IsMobileQuickButtonVisible:set(false)
	local v116 = v_u_24.lookAt(p115.Player.Character)
	local v117 = p115.Player.Character:FindFirstChild("Nametag")
	if v117 then
		v117.Enabled = false
	end
	v_u_16:PlayAnimation("Pose", {
		["FadeTime"] = 0
	})
	if not v116 then
		v_u_11:SelectLobbyMenu("Styles", true)
	end
end
function v36.OnClose(p118) -- name: OnClose
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_24, (ref) v_u_11, (ref) v_u_16
	v_u_24.lookAt(nil)
	v_u_11.IsMobileQuickButtonVisible:set(true)
	local v119 = p118.Player.Character:FindFirstChild("Nametag")
	v_u_16:StopStyleAnimations("Pose")
	v_u_16:StopStyleAnimations("PoseStart")
	if v119 then
		v119.Enabled = true
	end
end
function v36.GetPendingStyleData(p120) -- name: GetPendingStyleData
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_21
	local v121 = p120.PendingRoll:get()
	if v121 and v121.Slot == (p120.CurrentStyleSlot:get() or 1) then
		return v_u_21:Get(v121.Name)
	else
		return nil
	end
end
function v36.Spin(p_u_122, p123, p124) -- name: Spin

		it("should call the cancellation hook once", function()

	describe("Promise:finally", function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
		it("should be called upon resolve, reject, or cancel", function()

				p155()

		it("should reject when handler errors", function()

		it("should propagate cancellation downwards", function()

		it("should wait for all promises to be resolved and return their values", function()

	describe("Promise.fold", function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_6
		it("should return the initial value in a promise when the list is empty", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v237 = {}
			local v238 = v_u_1.fold({}, function()
				error("should not be called")
			end, v237)
			expect(v_u_1.is(v238)).to.equal(true)
			expect(v238:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Resolved)
			expect(v238:expect()).to.equal(v237)
		end)
		it("should accept promises in the list", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v_u_239 = nil
			local v243 = v_u_1.fold({ v_u_1.new(function(p240)
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_239
					v_u_239 = p240
				end), 2, 3 }, function(p241, p242)
				return p241 + p242
			end, 0)
			v_u_239(1)
			expect(v_u_1.is(v243)).to.equal(true)
			expect(v243:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Resolved)
			expect(v243:expect()).to.equal(6)
		end)
		it("should always return a promise even if the list or reducer don\'t use them", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_6
			local v247 = v_u_1.fold({ 1, 2, 3 }, function(p244, p245, p246)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
				if p246 == 2 then
					return v_u_1.delay(1):andThenReturn(p244 + p245)
				else
					return p244 + p245
				end
			end, 0)
			expect(v_u_1.is(v247)).to.equal(true)
			expect(v247:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			v_u_6(2)
			expect(v247:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Resolved)
			expect(v247:expect()).to.equal(6)
		end)
		it("should return the first rejected promise", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v251 = v_u_1.fold({ 1, 2, 3 }, function(p248, p249, p250)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
				if p250 == 2 then
					return v_u_1.reject("foo")
				else
					return p248 + p249
				end
			end, 0)
			expect(v_u_1.is(v251)).to.equal(true)
			local v252, v253 = v251:awaitStatus()
			expect(v252).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Rejected)
			expect(v253).to.equal("foo")
		end)
		it("should return the first canceled promise", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v_u_254 = nil
			local v258 = v_u_1.fold({ 1, 2, 3 }, function(p255, p256, p257)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_254, (ref) v_u_1
				if p257 == 1 then
					return p255 + p256
				end
				if p257 == 2 then
					v_u_254 = v_u_1.delay(1):andThenReturn(p255 + p256)
					return v_u_254
				end
				error("this should not run if the promise is cancelled")
			end, 0)
			expect(v_u_1.is(v258)).to.equal(true)
			expect(v258:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			v_u_254:cancel()
			expect(v258:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Cancelled)
		end)
	end)
	describe("Promise.race", function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
		it("should resolve with the first settled value", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1

			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1

			local v264 = v_u_1.race(v263)
			expect(v264:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Resolved)
			expect(v264._values[1]).to.equal(2)

			expect(v263[2]:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Cancelled)
			expect(v263[3]:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Resolved)
			local v265 = v_u_1.new(function() end)

			expect(v265:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Cancelled)

			expect(v267).to.be.ok()
			expect(v268:find("Non%-promise")).to.be.ok()
		end)
		it("should cancel promises if it is cancelled", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v269 = v_u_1.new(function() end)
			v269:andThen(function() end)
			local v270 = { v_u_1.new(function() end), v_u_1.new(function() end), v269 }
			v_u_1.race(v270):cancel()
			expect(v270[1]:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Cancelled)
			expect(v270[2]:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Cancelled)
			expect(v270[3]:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
		end)
	end)
	describe("Promise.promisify", function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
		it("should wrap functions", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v272 = v_u_1.promisify(function(p271) -- name: test
				return p271 + 1
			end)(1)
			local v273, v274 = v272:_unwrap()
			expect(v273).to.equal(true)
			expect(v272:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Resolved)
			expect(v274).to.equal(2)
		end)
		it("should catch errors after a yield", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v_u_275 = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
			local v276 = v_u_1.promisify(function()
				-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_275
				v_u_275.Event:Wait()
				error("errortext")
			end)()
			expect(v276:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			v_u_275:Fire()
			expect(v276:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Rejected)
			local v277 = expect
			local v278 = v276._values[1]
			v277(tostring(v278):find("errortext")).to.be.ok()
		end)
	end)
	describe("Promise.tap", function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
		it("should thread through values", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1

			local v_u_284 = nil
			local v_u_285 = nil

				return v_u_1.new(function(p286)
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_284
					v_u_284 = p286
				end)
			end):andThen(function(p287)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_285
				v_u_285 = p287
			end)

			expect(v_u_285).to.never.be.ok()

			expect(v288:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Resolved)
			expect(v_u_285).to.equal(1)
		end)
	end)

	describe("Promise.some", function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
		it("should resolve once the goal is reached", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v306 = v_u_1.some({ v_u_1.resolve(1), v_u_1.reject(), v_u_1.resolve(2) }, 2)
			expect(v306:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Resolved)
			expect(v306._values[1][1]).to.equal(1)
			expect(v306._values[1][2]).to.equal(2)
		end)
		it("should error if the goal can\'t be reached", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			expect(v_u_1.some({ v_u_1.resolve(), v_u_1.reject() }, 2):getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Rejected)
			local v_u_307 = nil
			local v309 = v_u_1.some({ v_u_1.resolve(), v_u_1.new(function(_, p308)
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_307
					v_u_307 = p308
				end) }, 2)
			expect(v309:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			v_u_307("foo")
			expect(v309:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Rejected)
			expect(v309._values[1]).to.equal("foo")
		end)
		it("should cancel pending Promises once the goal is reached", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v_u_310 = nil
			local v311 = v_u_1.new(function() end)
			local v313 = v_u_1.new(function(p312)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_310
				v_u_310 = p312
			end)
			local v314 = v_u_1.some({ v311, v313, v_u_1.resolve() }, 2)
			expect(v314:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			expect(v311:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			expect(v313:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			v_u_310()
			expect(v314:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Resolved)
			expect(v311:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Cancelled)
			expect(v313:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Resolved)
		end)
		it("should error if passed a non-number", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			expect(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
				v_u_1.some({}, "non-number")
			end).to.throw()
		end)
		it("should return an empty array if amount is 0", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v315 = v_u_1.some({ v_u_1.resolve(2) }, 0)
			expect(v315:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Resolved)
			expect(#v315._values[1]).to.equal(0)
		end)
		it("should not return extra values", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1

				v_u_1.resolve(1),
				v_u_1.resolve(2),
				v_u_1.resolve(3),
				v_u_1.resolve(4)
			}, 2)
			expect(v316:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Resolved)
			expect(#v316._values[1]).to.equal(2)
			expect(v316._values[1][1]).to.equal(1)
			expect(v316._values[1][2]).to.equal(2)
		end)
		it("should cancel promises if it is cancelled", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v317 = v_u_1.new(function() end)
			v317:andThen(function() end)
			local v318 = { v_u_1.new(function() end), v_u_1.new(function() end), v317 }
			v_u_1.some(v318, 3):cancel()
			expect(v318[1]:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Cancelled)
			expect(v318[2]:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Cancelled)
			expect(v318[3]:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
		end)
		describe("Promise.any", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			it("should return the value directly", function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
				local v319 = v_u_1.any({ v_u_1.reject(), v_u_1.reject(), v_u_1.resolve(1) })
				expect(v319:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Resolved)
				expect(v319._values[1]).to.equal(1)
			end)
			it("should error if all are rejected", function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1

			end)
		end)
	end)

		end)
	end)
	describe("Promise:await", function()

	describe("Promise:now", function()

	describe("Promise.each", function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
		it("should iterate", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v342, v343 = v_u_1.each({
				"foo",
				"bar",
				"baz",
				"qux"
			}, function(...)
				return { ... }
			end):_unwrap()
			expect(v342).to.equal(true)
			expect(v343[1][1]).to.equal("foo")
			expect(v343[1][2]).to.equal(1)
			expect(v343[2][1]).to.equal("bar")
			expect(v343[2][2]).to.equal(2)
			expect(v343[3][1]).to.equal("baz")
			expect(v343[3][2]).to.equal(3)
			expect(v343[4][1]).to.equal("qux")
			expect(v343[4][2]).to.equal(4)
		end)
		it("should iterate serially", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v_u_344 = {}
			local v_u_345 = {}
			local v351 = v_u_1.each({ "foo", "bar", "baz" }, function(p_u_346, p347)
				-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_345, (ref) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_344
				v_u_345[p347] = (v_u_345[p347] or 0) + 1
				return v_u_1.new(function(p_u_348)
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_344, (copy) p_u_346
					local v349 = v_u_344
					local function v350()
						-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_348, (ref) p_u_346
						p_u_348(p_u_346:upper())
					end
					table.insert(v349, v350)
				end)
			end)
			expect(v351:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			expect(#v_u_344).to.equal(1)
			expect(v_u_345[1]).to.equal(1)
			expect(v_u_345[2]).to.never.be.ok()
			table.remove(v_u_344, 1)()
			expect(v351:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			expect(#v_u_344).to.equal(1)
			expect(v_u_345[1]).to.equal(1)
			expect(v_u_345[2]).to.equal(1)
			expect(v_u_345[3]).to.never.be.ok()
			table.remove(v_u_344, 1)()
			expect(v351:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			expect(v_u_345[1]).to.equal(1)
			expect(v_u_345[2]).to.equal(1)
			expect(v_u_345[3]).to.equal(1)
			table.remove(v_u_344, 1)()
			expect(v351:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Resolved)
			local v352 = expect
			local v353 = v351._values[1]
			v352((type(v353))).to.equal("table")
			local v354 = expect
			local v355 = v351._values[2]
			v354((type(v355))).to.equal("nil")
			local v356 = v351._values[1]
			expect(v356[1]).to.equal("FOO")
			expect(v356[2]).to.equal("BAR")
			expect(v356[3]).to.equal("BAZ")
		end)
		it("should reject with the value if the predicate promise rejects", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v357 = v_u_1.each({ 1, 2, 3 }, function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
				return v_u_1.reject("foobar")
			end)
			expect(v357:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Rejected)
			expect(v357._values[1]).to.equal("foobar")
		end)
		it("should allow Promises to be in the list and wait when it gets to them", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v_u_358 = nil
			local v360 = { (v_u_1.new(function(p359)
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_358
					v_u_358 = p359
				end)) }
			local v362 = v_u_1.each(v360, function(p361)
				return p361 * 2
			end)
			expect(v362:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			v_u_358(2)
			expect(v362:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Resolved)
			expect(v362._values[1][1]).to.equal(4)
		end)
		it("should reject with the value if a Promise from the list rejects", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v_u_363 = false
			local v364 = v_u_1.each({ 1, 2, v_u_1.reject("foobar") }, function(_)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_363
				v_u_363 = true
				return "never"
			end)
			expect(v364:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Rejected)
			expect(v364._values[1]).to.equal("foobar")
			expect(v_u_363).to.equal(false)
		end)
		it("should reject immediately if there\'s a cancelled Promise in the list initially", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v365 = v_u_1.new(function() end)
			v365:cancel()
			local v_u_366 = false
			local v367 = v_u_1.each({ 1, 2, v365 }, function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_366
				v_u_366 = true
			end)
			expect(v367:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Rejected)
			expect(v_u_366).to.equal(false)
			expect(v367._values[1].kind).to.equal(v_u_1.Error.Kind.AlreadyCancelled)
		end)
		it("should stop iteration if Promise.each is cancelled", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v_u_368 = {}
			local v370 = v_u_1.each({ "foo", "bar", "baz" }, function(_, p369)
				-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_368, (ref) v_u_1
				v_u_368[p369] = (v_u_368[p369] or 0) + 1
				return v_u_1.new(function() end)
			end)
			expect(v370:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Started)
			expect(v_u_368[1]).to.equal(1)
			expect(v_u_368[2]).to.never.be.ok()
			v370:cancel()
			expect(v370:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Cancelled)
			expect(v_u_368[1]).to.equal(1)
			expect(v_u_368[2]).to.never.be.ok()
		end)
		it("should cancel the Promise returned from the predicate if Promise.each is cancelled", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v_u_371 = nil
			v_u_1.each({ "foo", "bar", "baz" }, function(_, _)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_371, (ref) v_u_1
				v_u_371 = v_u_1.new(function() end)
				return v_u_371
			end):cancel()
			expect(v_u_371:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Cancelled)
		end)
		it("should cancel Promises in the list if Promise.each is cancelled", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v372 = v_u_1.new(function() end)
			v_u_1.each({ v372 }, function() end):cancel()
			expect(v372:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Cancelled)
		end)
	end)
	describe("Promise.retry", function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
		it("should retry N times", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v_u_373 = 0
			local v375 = v_u_1.retry(function(p374)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_373, (ref) v_u_1
				expect(p374).to.equal("foo")
				v_u_373 = v_u_373 + 1
				if v_u_373 == 5 then
					return v_u_1.resolve("ok")
				else
					return v_u_1.reject("fail")
				end
			end, 5, "foo")
			expect(v375:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Resolved)
			expect(v375._values[1]).to.equal("ok")
		end)
		it("should reject if threshold is exceeded", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
			local v376 = v_u_1.retry(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
				return v_u_1.reject("fail")
			end, 5)
			expect(v376:getStatus()).to.equal(v_u_1.Status.Rejected)
			expect(v376._values[1]).to.equal("fail")
		end)
	end)
	describe("Promise.retryWithDelay", function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_6
		it("should retry after a delay", function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_6

local function v_u_771(p755, ...) -- name: world_query
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_691
	local v756 = {}
	local v757 = { ... }
	local v758 = p755.archetypes
	local v759 = p755.component_index
	local v760 = v_u_691
	local v761 = setmetatable({
		["ids"] = v757,
		["compatible_archetypes"] = v756,
		["world"] = p755
	}, v760)
	local v762 = nil
	local v763 = 0
	for _, v764 in v757 do
		local v765 = v759[v764]
		if not v765 then
			return v761
		end
		if v762 ~= nil and v765.size >= v762.size then
			continue
		end
		v762 = v765
	end
	if not v762 then
		return v761
	end
	for v766 in v762.columns do
		local v767 = v758[v766]
		if #v767.entities == 0 then
			continue
		end
		local v768 = v767.records
		local v769 = false
		for _, v770 in v757 do
			if v768[v770] then
				continue
			end
			v769 = true
		end
		if v769 then
			break
		end
		v763 = v763 + 1
		v756[v763] = v767
	end
	return v761
end

local function v_u_345(p335, p336, p337) -- name: updateLines
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_106, (ref) v_u_334, (copy) v_u_28, (copy) v_u_333, (copy) v_u_279, (copy) v_u_310
	local v338 = v_u_9.WindVariation
	local v339 = p336 * 0.37
	local v340 = math.sin(v339) * 0.6
	local v341 = p336 * 1.13 + 1.7
	local v342 = 1 + v338 * (v340 + math.sin(v341) * 0.4)
	local v343 = v_u_9.WindSpeed * v342 * (1 + v_u_9.GustStrength * v_u_106(p336))
	v_u_334 = v_u_334 + v_u_9.LineDensity * v_u_28.area / 1000 * (1 + 2.5 * p337) * p335
	while v_u_334 >= 1 do
		v_u_334 = v_u_334 - 1
		v_u_333()
	end
	for _, v344 in ipairs(v_u_279) do
		if v344.active then
			if v344.enableNext then
				v344.enableNext = false
				v344.trail.Enabled = true
			end
			v344.s = v344.s + v343 * v344.speedMul * p335
			v_u_310(v344)
			if v344.s < v344.len then
				continue
			end
			v344.active = false

		else
			if v344.cooldown <= 0 then

			end

		end
	end
end
